searchText: After our month-long break, AllCoreDevs is back tomorrow: Thursday Oct. 27, 14:00 UTC 😄 ! Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/624 Stream: https://youtu.be/oQfEW8LdE88 Zoom: to be shared here shortly before the call is anyone from Solidity going to be on the call? Specifically we'd like to hear their appetite and timing for implementing language features on top of EOF stuff. the other thing that would be fun is some elaboration on the usecases for the BLS precompiles. What i've heard so far is mainly for rollups... what other use cases are there and how do those users feel about the prottypes that are out there?
